# Holton Le Clay Cars

> Holton Le Clay Cars is an independent used car dealer in Grimsby, North East Lincolnshire. We began as a service and MOT centre serving the city for over 20 years and have been selling used cars for just over five. We offer finance from 10.4% APR (representative 19.9% APR), welcome part exchange, and include a minimum 3-month warranty with every car.

Based at Peacefield Business Park, Nickerson Way, Holton-le-Clay, Grimsby DN36 5HS, we offer finance (credit broker, not a lender), part exchange, a minimum 3-month warranty with extended 6 and 12 month options, and 3 years free servicing and MOT tests (subject to East Grimsby MOT and Repair Centre Limited).
